method: The coordinator read the full question, completion and both original labels/notes for all 28 D-disagreement records. The groups below were explicitly assigned after that reading; no text classifier or keyword annotation was used. These are explanatory themes, not replacement outcome labels.

groups.interpretation_boundary: 冒頭のYesを独立した直接判断にも数えるか、後続の第三人称報告の導入と読むか。
Morganの回答は、回答なら、回答すべき内容は、という見出し・提示を直接発話か報告として読むか。
報告枠の後続文・引用外の文・分詞節が独立した直接判断になるか。
Active response instructionという再掲見出しの下の文を、指示内容か実行された回答かと読むか。
編集者の勤勉さへの記述が、原問の同期性能への判断も含むか。

finding: 27 of 28 disagreements primarily concern attribution or whether a heading/report presents an executed direct answer; one primarily concerns the target of the judgment. Counts describe this selected disagreement set, not prevalence across all outputs.
scope: The coordinator knows the study design and outcomes; this reading is not blinded, independent construct validation or a human gold standard.
